CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  December 4, 2023

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 6:59 P.M. in the Council Chambers of Alhambra City Hall,
  and via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson

  Absent:  Mojarro

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Maia McCurley, Principal Planner;
  Megan Wu, Associate Planner; Kassandra Cornejo, Assistant Planner; Erica
  Vega, Deputy City Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Olson

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  MINUTES – November 20, 2023 (7:00 P.M.)
  • Request: This is a request for the Planning Commission to approve
  the Minutes of the November 20, 2023, Regular Meeting of the
  Alhambra Planning Commission.
  • Recommended Action: Commission review and approve as
  submitted the Minutes of the November 20, 2023, Regular Meeting
  of the Alhambra Planning Commission.

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve Consent Agenda Item 1.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 7-0-2-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Tsujii, Garcia
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: Pham, Olson
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  For additional information regarding the discussion, the audio and video
  recordings of the discussion is available here:
  Audio:
  PC Meeting - December 4, 2023 (audio).m4a

  12/04/2023
   Video:
  PC Meeting - December 4, 2023 (video).mp4

E.  DISCUSSION ITEMS:

  •  There were no Discussion items.

F.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA:

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to re-order the agenda to move Agenda Item 3 before Agenda Item
  2.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Tsujii.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

G.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 3:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-22-27 AND LOT MERGER
  LOTM-23-05 (7:02 P.M.)
  • 24 & 28 East Valley Boulevard
  • Request: This is a continuation of the public hearing for an
  application for a Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-27 and a Lot
  Merger LOTM-23-05 to combine two (2) parcels into one (1) parcel
  and to establish a motor vehicle sales use, with accessory repair
  services, within an existing commercial retail lease space located in
  the VSP (Valley Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-35 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-27 and Lot Merger LOTM-23-05
  subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding Conditional Use
  Permit CUP-22-27 and Lot Merger LOTM-23-05 to be exempt from
  review under the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA)
  pursuant to Sections 15301, Class 1 and 15305, Class 5 of Title 14 of
  the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA
  review projects that are existing facilities and that are minor
  alterations in land use limitations, respectively.
  • Principal Planner Maia McCurley provided the Staff presentation.
  • Ming Liu and Danny Chen, applicant and business owner,
  respectively, were available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  2
  12/04/2023
 MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with two (2) added conditions of approval to: 1.)
  Replace the chain link fencing at the rear portion of the site with wrought-
  iron fencing consistent with the proposed new parking lot fencing and 2.)
  Coordinate with Staff to adjust the proposed new landscape areas to
  accommodate the storage and placement of any required trash
  containers/receptacles.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Juarez, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia,
  Olson
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent: Mojarro

AGENDA
ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-37 AND VARIANCE
  VAR-22-09 (7:20 P.M.)
  • 69 East Main Street
  • Request: This is a continuation of the public hearing for an
  application for a Planned Development Permit PD-22-37 and a
  Variance VAR-22-09 to establish a discount variety store, Dollar
  Tree, in an existing commercial lease space with less than the required
  number of parking spaces located at 69 East Main Street in the CBD
  (Central Business District) zone and Downtown Revitalization
  District Overlay.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-10 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-37 and Variance VAR-22-09 subject to
  the Conditions of Approval, and finding Planned Development Permit
  PD-22-37 and Variance VAR-22-09 to be exempt from review under
  the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to
  Section 15301, Class 1 of Title 14 of the California Code of
  Regulations, which exempts from CEQA review projects that are
  existing facilities.
  • Assistant Planner Kassandra Cornejo provided the Staff
  presentation.
  • Steven Schechter of HCP Alhambra, LLC and Scott Burns of
  JLL, the property owner and leasing agent, provided the Applicant
  presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Lewis McCammon
  2.) Michael Lawrence
  3.) Ted Slaught
  3
  12/04/2023
   4.) John Bwarie
  5.) Jeff Forman

MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve with two (2) added conditions of approval to: 1.)
  Incorporate a window, with visual permeability from the outside to the
  inside of the store, along the Main Street façade of the building and 2.)
  Consider ways to utilize the building as a canvas with the incorporation
  of a more significant mural or artwork that activates the sidewalk.
  •  Moved by Vice President Garcia, Seconded by Commissioner Gardea.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 8-0-1-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Gardea, Grijalva, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  None
  Recuse: Juarez
  Absent: Mojarro

RECESS:
  •  Recess at 8:42 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 8:47 P.M.

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  PLANNED  DEVELOPMENT  PERMIT  PD-23-53  AND
  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-23-21 (8:47 P.M.)
  • 1146 South Meridian Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-23-53 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-21 to allow for the
  construction of a 154,752 square foot, four-story self-storage facility
  located on a site of approximately 1.78 acres within the IPD
  (Industrial Planned Development) zone.
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 23-34 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-53 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-
  21 subject to the Conditions of Approval, and finding Planned
  Development Permit PD-23-53 and Conditional Use Permit CUP-23-
  21 to be exempt from review under the California Environmental
  Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Section 15332, Class 32 of Title 14
  of the California Code of Regulations, which exempts from CEQA
  review projects that are characterized as in-fill development.
  • Associate Planner Megan Wu provided the Staff presentation.
  • Ed Casey (Land Use Counsel of Alston & Bird), Kara Tobin
  (Applicant on behalf of PAL Alhambra Storage, LLC), and Scott
  Jones (Project Architect of AO Architects) provided the Applicant
  presentation.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.

  4
  12/04/2023
   MOTION:
  •  Moved to deny the project based on the project not furthering the City’s
  General Plan Land Use Element, land use and community design goals,
  and not enhancing the City’s quality of life goals, specifically,
  enhancement of commercial and industrial areas to attract jobs and
  expand the City’s tax base.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Gardea, Seconded by Commissioner Grijalva.
  •  The motion failed by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 2-6-1-1
  Ayes:  Gardea, Grijalva
  Noes:  Bryden, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Recuse: Juarez
  Absent: Mojarro

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to approve.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Tsujii, Seconded by Commissioner Pham.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 6-2-1-1
  Ayes:  Bryden, Ho, Pham, Tsujii, Garcia, Olson
  Noes:  Gardea, Grijalva
  Recuse: Juarez
  Absent: Mojarro

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

  REPORTS:

  •  There were no Comments from Staff.
